description: Applied manually in Cloudflare on 2026-11-12. Profile-only Managed Challenge, after the verified-crawler exception. Does not challenge homepage, petitions, organizations, magazine or admin. The origin retains per-IP and global safeguards.
name: Protect public profiles — verified crawlers exempt
expression: http.host in {"www.freecause.com" "freecause.com"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and not cf.client.bot and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin") and (http.request.uri.path contains "/user/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/usuario/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/utilisateur/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/benutzer/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/utente/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/ususario/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/anvandare/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/bruger/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/gebruiker/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/kullanici/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/utentes/")
